conditions: The source must bind the exact admitted Design result it consumes.
excludes: Generated views, calculated IDs and digests, validator decisions, owner approvals, and execution receipts.
includes: Author-controlled Work Pack meaning, requested effect, route bindings, and readiness configuration.

definitions.misuse_warning: A schema-valid source is not a generated Plan, an admitted Plan, or an execution-ready Work Pack.
definitions.promotion_boundary: The Invoke Plan owner must accept any later change to the canonical Plan source contract.
definitions.use_carefully: Do not copy calculated output fields back into the authoring source.

voices.domain_context: In Invoke Plan, this replaces scattered author-controlled fields across generated Work Pack files and receipts while retaining the current plan-execution-source v1 as migration evidence.
voices.formal: For one Plan candidate P, exactly one authored source S supplies all meaning-bearing inputs; every generated member of P must be a deterministic function of the exact bytes of S and its bound predecessor evidence.
voices.normative: The Plan authoring source is the sole machine-readable document whose authored fields state the proposed Work Pack, requested effect, route contracts, and readiness configuration for one Plan candidate.
voices.operational: Complete the source request, bind one admitted Design predecessor, author the canonical source into an absent file, and pass that file unchanged to the Plan compiler.
voices.plain_language: The one JSON file where we write what the Plan is supposed to contain before tools generate the rest.

conditions: Every bundle member comes from the same exact Plan authoring source and producer run.
excludes: Independent admission, implementation readiness, owner acceptance, task execution, and product mutation.
includes: Every required generated Plan file and the exact producer receipt for that generation.

definitions.misuse_warning: Generation success alone does not prove that the bundle is current or accepted by its consumers.
definitions.promotion_boundary: Only an accepted Plan successor contract may make this inventory canonical.
definitions.use_carefully: Name the exact bundle inventory and producer identity whenever this term is used as evidence.

voices.domain_context: The bundle contains the Work Pack and its supporting planning, layering, trace, and producer evidence; it is not the execution of that Work Pack.
voices.formal: Bundle B is a candidate for source S only when the required inventory is complete and each byte sequence in B equals the compiler projection of S under one declared producer identity.
voices.normative: A Plan candidate bundle is the complete ordered set of files deterministically generated from one exact Plan authoring source and its bound predecessor evidence.
voices.operational: Compile the exact source into an absent directory, verify the required inventory, and keep the stage receipt with the bundle for independent admission.
voices.plain_language: All Plan files produced together from one source, held for checking before anyone treats them as accepted.

conditions: The admission validator is a different executable identity from the Plan bundle producer.
excludes: Semantic invention, Design revision, owner acceptance, implementation readiness, execution authorization, and product mutation.
includes: Clean replay, exact inventory comparison, predecessor freshness, structural validation, and declared consumer results.

definitions.misuse_warning: Admission does not prove the Work Pack can execute safely and does not authorize any task.
definitions.promotion_boundary: The Invoke Plan owner owns the admitted inventory and consumer contract; execution owners retain later readiness decisions.
definitions.use_carefully: Treat admission as stale after any bound source, predecessor, producer, schema, inventory, or consumer change.

voices.domain_context: Plan admission sits after deterministic generation and before capability status. Work Pack Readiness Audit and Implementation Readiness remain separate later proofs.
voices.formal: Admission A(B,S) is current only when independent replay of S yields byte-equal B, required consumer checks pass, bound predecessor evidence is current, and the admitted inventory and producer identities equal the submitted ones.
voices.normative: Plan bundle admission is an independent point-in-time result that replays one exact Plan authoring source, compares every required bundle member, and runs the declared structural and consumer checks for that exact candidate.
voices.operational: Give the validator the exact candidate bundle; it must rehash inputs, replay generation in isolation, compare every file, collect all reachable blockers, and emit a separate receipt.
voices.plain_language: A second checker proves that this exact generated Plan still matches its source and works with the checks that depend on it.

conditions: Every positive axis is supported by current evidence owned by the producer or validator responsible for that axis.
excludes: A single generic PASS, inferred readiness, inferred acceptance, and inferred execution permission.
includes: Separate authored, admitted, readiness, acceptance, and execution-authority axes with exact receipt references.

definitions.misuse_warning: Artifact-authored or bundle-admitted status must never be presented as implementation-ready, accepted, or execution-authorized.
definitions.promotion_boundary: Each downstream owner controls only its evidence axis; no single resolver may manufacture missing authority.
definitions.use_carefully: Report each evidence axis and its exact receipt instead of summarizing the Plan with an untyped PASS.

voices.domain_context: Invoke uses this state to hand a Plan successor into later readiness and execution workflows without collapsing artifact PASS into permission to mutate a product.
voices.formal: For Plan P, evidence state E is a product of independent axes including authored, admitted, implementation-ready, owner-accepted, and execution-authorized; truth on one axis does not imply truth on another.
voices.normative: A Plan evidence state is the typed statement of the highest Plan claim established by exact current receipts, while preserving all later unproved or unauthorized states as separate fields.
voices.operational: Resolve status from the exact producer and admission receipts, then attach later readiness, acceptance, and execution evidence only to their own named axes.
voices.plain_language: A precise answer to what we have proved about the Plan so far, without turning 'written' into 'ready' or 'approved.'

distill.rationale: The four terms form one bounded chain from authored Plan input through generated bundle and admission to typed evidence reporting.

identity_denominator.rationale: The candidate introduces no label-to-executable mapping or exact identity denominator beyond stable definition IDs.

layering.rationale: Define fixes the meanings and boundaries only; Design must decide the successor schemas, compiler, admission validator, capability-status integration, and migration layers.

semantic_applications.rationale: The canonical registry contains no term for the single authored machine input to the Plan successor pipeline.
The canonical registry has general artifact terms but no scoped term for the complete deterministic Plan output set.
No canonical term names an independent point-in-time replay of a generated Plan bundle while preserving later readiness gates.
The current Plan documents describe separate evidence ceilings, but the scoped state that preserves them has no canonical definition.

spec_declarations.statement: The Plan successor must have one machine-readable authoring source; every human view, bundle file, and producer receipt is derived from that exact source.
spec_declarations.title: One authored source

spec_declarations.statement: A generated Plan bundle may establish a new artifact PASS only after a separate validator replays the source, compares every required file, and runs the declared Plan consumers.
spec_declarations.title: Admission is independent

spec_declarations.statement: Bundle admission does not establish Work Pack readiness, implementation readiness, owner acceptance, or execution authority; each later state requires its own exact evidence.
spec_declarations.title: Readiness remains separate

spec_declarations.statement: Plan consumes one exact admitted Design result and may expose a missing planning detail, but it must not silently revise the Design decision while producing the Work Pack.
spec_declarations.title: Admitted Design is bound input

spec_declarations.statement: The Plan v1 source, compiler, and receipts remain available for validation and migration evidence but cannot establish a new successor-format PASS.
spec_declarations.title: Current Plan remains historical input
